name: Sofia's Configurable Inventory
author: Sofia
description: Configurable slot counts for all 4 Player Inventory Tabs (Main Bag, Runes, Ammo, Quest Items) and Storage Chests with smart item relocation, save-load item protection, and non-destructive weight scaling.

settings.label: Enable Configurable Inventory
settings.tooltip: Master switch for Sofia's Configurable Inventory. Turning this off restores vanilla tab sizes while protecting items in high slots.

settings.label: Main Bag Slots
settings.tooltip: Number of slots in the Main Items tab (Vanilla: 32). Supports steps of 4.

settings.label: Runes Tab Slots
settings.tooltip: Number of slots in the Runes tab (Vanilla: 24). Supports steps of 4.

settings.label: Ammo Tab Slots
settings.tooltip: Number of slots in the Arrows & Bolts tab (Vanilla: 24). Supports steps of 4.

settings.label: Quest Items Tab Slots
settings.tooltip: Number of slots in the Quest Items tab (Vanilla: 24). Supports steps of 4.

settings.label: Expand Player Storage Chests
settings.tooltip: Expands player-built storage containers while safely skipping crafting and processing stations.

settings.label: Storage Chest Slots
settings.tooltip: Number of slots in player-built storage chests. Lowering this compacts items into earlier slots automatically.

settings.label: Weightless Items (Zero Weight)
settings.tooltip: Sets all item weights to 0.0 non-destructively in memory. Disabling restores original weights immediately.

settings.label: Item Weight Multiplier
settings.tooltip: Scales all item weights when Weightless Items is off (e.g. 0.5x = half weight, 1.0x = vanilla weight).

settings.label: Hide Inventory Scroll Bar
settings.tooltip: Collapses the vertical scroll bar visual while keeping mouse-wheel scrolling active.

settings.label: Force Apply & Relocate Hotkey
settings.tooltip: Press this key in-game to re-apply all slot sizes, rebuild UI grids, and relocate misplaced items.

settings.label: Verbose Debug Logging
settings.tooltip: Prints detailed template patching, UI rebuilding, and item relocation logs to UE4SS.log.

settings.label: APPLY SLOTS & RELOCATE ITEMS NOW
settings.tooltip: Immediately applies current tab & chest sizes, rebuilds inventory UI grids, and migrates items into their proper tabs.
